title: Quick Filipino Egg Bicol Express
description: A grassy, springy, kid-friendly Filipino dish that uses cream of tartar to fluff eggs and en-croute shrimp for a tender bite, all cooked in one skillet for a quick lunch.
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add diced onion and minced garlic, sauté until fragrant and translucent, about 2 minutes.
Stir in sliced chili and shrimp, coat shrimp with cornstarch, and cook until shrimp are pink, about 3 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and fish sauce, bring to a gentle simmer, letting flavors meld for 2 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk together eggs, cream of tartar, salt, and pepper until frothy.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet, stirring gently, allowing the eggs to set into soft curds while still moist.
Remove from heat when the eggs are fully cooked but still springy, about 2 minutes.
Serve the dish immediately, topping with fresh lime wedges for a bright finish.
Enjoy the grassy, springy Quick Filipino Egg Bicol Express with a kid-friendly twist.
